cases.name: committed_selected_intent
cases.given: a selected intent and exact route commit with its checkpoint and journal record
cases.when: an authorized current worker claims it
cases.then: one fenced attempt may dispatch the pinned handler

cases.name: uncommitted_intent
cases.given: evaluation emitted an intent but checkpoint commit failed
cases.then: no claim, provider call, or journal insertion

cases.name: route_generation_changed
cases.then: reject with no checkpoint, journal, or provider mutation

cases.name: equal_request_after_route_change
cases.given: a committed operation receipt and pinned route
cases.when: the same operation is replayed after route configuration changes
cases.then: return the saved response and route without alias resolution

cases.name: revoked_dispatch
cases.given: a pinned route whose current permission is revoked
cases.then: retain pending work and make no provider call

cases.name: accepted_outbox_pending_business
cases.given: the worker transport durably accepts the intent
cases.then: business invocation remains outstanding until an authenticated terminal outcome

cases.name: wrong_token
cases.when: the result supplies a different business token
cases.then: effect_not_outstanding before core admission; bytes unchanged

cases.name: wrong_scope_or_principal
cases.given: a valid effect ID and business token
cases.then: authorization failure before existence disclosure, admission, or mutation

cases.name: old_epoch_or_fence
cases.given: a worker from an expired claim
cases.then: stale_attempt_fence before core admission; bytes unchanged

cases.name: equal_and_conflicting_result
cases.given: a recorded terminal outcome and accepted event
cases.when: equal then unequal results are submitted
cases.then: equal returns retained receipt; unequal returns effect_result_conflict without mutation

cases.name: crash_after_provider_acceptance
cases.then: attempt is ambiguous; retry only with destination deduplication or reconciliation

cases.name: crash_after_outcome_commit
cases.then: admit the pinned event once without invoking provider again

cases.name: cancellation_before_claim
cases.given: a committed cancellation before any claim

cases.name: cancellation_after_possible_call
cases.then: retain ambiguous work pending proof or reconciliation
